recent.text: Christian Braun 20 points 8 rebounds tonight. Despite some missed opportunities in transition, he’s scored 15+ points in 5 consecutive games and 6 of the last 7. He’s averaging 14.2 PPG and shooting 36.9% from 3, while ranking fourth in the league in steals per game (2.1).
recent.author: Bennett Durando

recent.text: Jamal Murray was terrific tonight, and his 36 points led Denver to the victory in Utah. Recap here! https://t.co/vkmYfoNR0k
recent.author: Denver Stiffs

recent.text: Jamal Murray scored 13 of his 36 in the last 5:02, Nikola Jokic added 15 assists to mask a strange scoring game, and the Nuggets pulled away late to beat Utah 120-107. They finished 3-1 with a +10 point differential in NBA Cup play, but it’s not enough to advance. 11-6 overall.
recent.author: Bennett Durando

recent.text: The lineups with Nikola Jokic + 4 bench players have yielded some of Denver’s worst stints this season, always at the end of the first/third Q. It was 80-77 tonight, late third. That lineup gave up a 4-0 run that felt more significant with non-Jokic/non-Murray minutes looming.
recent.author: Bennett Durando

recent.text: Christian Braun joked last Friday that he only shoots well in NBA Cup games and hoped every game from now on could be for the Cup. He’s on a heat check in the third quarter against Dallas, and Denver has trimmed a 21pt deficit to 6.
recent.author: Bennett Durando

recent.text: Seven of the 10 Nuggets who played in that half committed a turnover. No Julian Strawther.
recent.author: Bennett Durando
recent.quoted_text: Nuggets, who have the fourth-lowest turnover rate in the NBA, coughed it up 11 times in the first half against Dallas, most of them live-ball turnovers. Mavericks have outscored Denver 19-2 in fast-break points and that's good enough for a 58-39 halftime margin.
